summary: A controller firmware that maps the FM-1's keys, knobs and buttons to the VIBE FM, its Web Player and VST, or any MIDI software. The FM-1 makes no sound itself.
features: Keys send notes at fixed velocity 100 on channel 1
Knobs and encoders as relative CCs; buttons as CC on/off
SAVE and GLO holds for SHIFT, STOP, arrows and soft keys F1-F6
Screen shows the host's page and knob values via SysEx
Shows a converted FM-1 firmware's own screen when the host runs one
PLAY blinks to incoming MIDI clock
